title: Account attachment updated
description: Generated after updating account‑level attachment overrides via the `PATCH /v1/deposits/accounts/{accountId}/attachment` endpoint. The payload contains the persisted override values, which consumers should regard as the authoritative state for the attachment.

program_id.title: Program Identifier
program_id.description: Program identifier the account belongs to.

product_id.title: Product Identifier
product_id.description: Deposit product identifier currently attached to the account. UUID v4 format.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Timestamp of the override update. the value must be RFC3339-compliant.

interest_capitalization_mode.title: Interest Capitalization Mode
interest_capitalization_mode.description: How capitalized interest is treated for the attachment. Emitted at top level, reflecting the attachment's effective mode. `REINVEST` (default) or `PAYOUT`.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within your organization

overrides.title: Attachment overrides
overrides.description: A saved record of the per‑attachment overrides applied on top of the product defaults. This object appears only when at least one override was provided, and each field is included only if it was explicitly set.

maturity_instructions_override.title: Maturity instructions override
maturity_instructions_override.description: Override that controls the deposit's behavior at maturity. Any field you omit follows the normal fallback sequence, moving from the account level to the program and then to the product defaults.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: Specifies how the principal is handled once the deposit matures.

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: Specifies how the interest is handled once the deposit matures.

renewal_term_override.title: Renewal term override
renewal_term_override.description: Term applied on each rollover. The Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) event renders the normalized persisted form, consisting of `unit` and `value`.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the renewal term.

renewal_calendar_maturity_date.title: Renewal calendar maturity date
renewal_calendar_maturity_date.description: Returned only when the request uses the calendar format. Format = `YYYY-MM-DD`.

penalties_override.title: Penalties override
penalties_override.description: Saved overrides for each penalty type. Only types with configured overrides appear. Each entry includes waived, the relevant type‑specific fields, and an optional `valid_until` used for scheduled rollback.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional audit-trail reason for the whole penalties block.

grace_period_override.title: Grace period override
grace_period_override.description: Grace‑period override. Type‑specific fields are optional, and any field you omit follows the normal fallback sequence.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` = fully exempt; `false` = penalty active (customized via the fields below).

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override via EventBridge. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: Defines how many days after opening the penalty becomes applicable..

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of days multiplied by the applicable interest rate to determine the penalty.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Future ISO 8601 datetime that schedules the revert of this override.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value of the withdrawal fee. Must be greater than 0.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Future ISO 8601 datetime that schedules the revert of this override.

tiered_interest_forfeiture_override.title: Tiered interest forfeiture override
tiered_interest_forfeiture_override.description: Tiered interest forfeiture override. Tiers replace the product's tiers when provided.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: List of tier definitions. Each tier replaces the product's tier configuration.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Future ISO 8601 datetime that schedules the revert of this override.

tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.title: Tiered interest forfeiture tier
tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.description: Single tier in a tiered interest forfeiture override.

min_days_held.title: Minimum days held
min_days_held.description: Minimum number of days the deposit must be held for this tier to apply.

max_days_held.title: Maximum days held
max_days_held.description: Maximum number of days the deposit can remain in this tier. If omitted, the tier has no maximum duration.

forfeited_interest_days.title: Forfeited interest days
forfeited_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty for this tier.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: Specifies how many days after a withdrawal the Pismo platform continues to treat a new withdrawal as penalty‑eligible.

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as the penalty amount.

window_behavior.title: Window behavior
window_behavior.description: Controls how the penalty window behaves after each withdrawal. `ROLLING` resets the window on every withdrawal, and `FIXED` sets it on the first withdrawal and keeps it unchanged

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Future ISO 8601 datetime that schedules the revert of this override.
